sloka: एष एव आशम्सते लंकाम् स्वेन अनीकेन मर्दितुम् ।विक्रान्तो बलवान् शूरः पौरुषे स्वे व्यवस्थितः ॥६-२७-४५॥।।
transliteration: eṣa eva āśamsate laṁkām svena anīkena marditum ।vikrānto balavān śūraḥ pauruṣe sve vyavasthitaḥ ॥6-27-45॥।।

translations.english: "He is indomitable, strong and heroic. He will not give up his virility. For the pleasure of Rama, he will not feel pity for his life (he will give up his life)."
